-- TISSUE CULTURE LINES (AX4)
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS tissue_culture_lines (
  id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  line_id VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  plant_latin_name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
  origin VARCHAR(255),
  method ENUM('meristem', 'callus', 'somatic_embryo', 'protoplast', 'other') DEFAULT 'meristem',
  status ENUM('active', 'dormant', 'cryopreserved', 'lost', 'distributed') DEFAULT 'active',
  storage ENUM('in_vitro', '-20C', '-80C', 'LN2', 'field') DEFAULT 'in_vitro',
  notes TEXT,
  axis_id VARCHAR(50) DEFAULT 'AX4_CONSERVATION_BIOTECH',
  created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  INDEX tcl_plant_idx (plant_latin_name),
  INDEX tcl_status_idx (status)
);

-- FERMENTATION RUNS (AX4)
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS perfumum_fermentation_runs (
  id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  run_id VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  target_molecule VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
  host ENUM('S_cerevisiae', 'E_coli', 'Y_lipolytica', 'Other') NOT NULL,
  gene_source VARCHAR(255),
  bioreactor_l DECIMAL(10,2),
  yield_g_l DECIMAL(10,4),
  purity_percent DECIMAL(5,2),
  notes TEXT,
  axis_id VARCHAR(50) DEFAULT 'AX4_CONSERVATION_BIOTECH',
  created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  INDEX pfr_molecule_idx (target_molecule)
);

-- BIOTECH MOLECULES (AX4)
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS biotech_molecules (
  id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  molecule_id VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  molecule_name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
  natural_source VARCHAR(255),
  cas_number VARCHAR(20),
  heterologous_genes JSON,
  host_organism VARCHAR(100),
  yield_mg_l DECIMAL(10,2),
  purity_percent DECIMAL(5,2),
  production_status ENUM('research', 'pilot', 'commercial', 'discontinued') DEFAULT 'research',
  advantages JSON,
  limitations JSON,
  notes TEXT,
  axis_id VARCHAR(50) DEFAULT 'AX4_CONSERVATION_BIOTECH',
  created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  INDEX bm_name_idx (molecule_name)
);
